reviews.text:
Definitely my choice for toner.
I bought it 3 times already and will buy again when I'm done. 
Great absorption and smooth feel.
reviews.zh:
絕對係我嘅爽膚水之選。
已經回購第 3 次，用完會再買。
吸收力強，觸感滑溜。

reviews.text: It’s soothing as the labeling said
reviews.zh: 同標籤講嘅一樣，有舒緩效果。

reviews.text: Great glass bottle packaging. Heard alot about this Toner, can’t wait to see result
reviews.zh: 玻璃瓶包裝好正。聽咗好多人講呢支爽膚水，好期待睇下效果。

reviews.text: Absolutely love it for under makeup
reviews.zh: 用嚟做底妝打底真係超愛。

reviews.text: האמת שעוד לא הספקתי להשתמש במוצר, רק הזמנתי אותו והוא הגיע
reviews.zh: 老實講我仲未用到個產品，淨係訂咗，佢送到咗。

reviews.text: Great milky toner! I bought it for winter season in the southern hemisphere and it’s exactly what my skin needs
reviews.zh: 好正嘅奶肌爽膚水！我喺南半球買嚟冬天用，啱啱啱我嘅皮膚需要。

reviews.text: Love this toner. Leaves me glowy all day.
reviews.zh: 好愛呢支爽膚水。成日都 keep 住水光感。

reviews.text:
It is moisturising, absorbs quickly but feels a little bit oily when first applied.
My skin feels really soft the next morning.
My first milky toner, think it is better for nighttime use or in winter.
reviews.zh:
有保濕力，吸收快，但剛搽嗰陣會有少少油笠笠。
第二朝皮膚摸落真係好軟。
我第一支奶肌爽膚水，覺得夜晚用或者冬天用會好啲。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
